caveat: Source-records request rows track collection workflow only. Missing, partial, denied, delayed, or redirected records do not prove fraud, misconduct, or tampering.

requests.requestLabel: Alaska write-ins, geometry, turnout semantics, baselines, and admin context
requests.requestedRecords: Official U.S. House write-in allocation by reporting unit or source confirmation of omission; reporting-unit geometry/crosswalk; ENR Reg_voters and total_ballots field semantics; official 2020, 2016, and 2012 presidential baselines; CVR availability, audit, recount, incident, correction, litigation, and records-request response artifacts.
requests.evidenceSummary: Official ENRbyPrecinct rows are loaded for President and named U.S. House first-choice candidates, but U.S. House write-ins are 750 votes short at reporting-unit grain and mixed reporting units are not geometry-ready. ENR turnout fields reconcile statewide but need denominator semantics before replacing EAC fallback.
requests.preparedAction: Prepared a state-level draft and packet reference. The app can copy the draft, open a mail client, and collect response metadata through GitHub.
requests.manualUserAction: Verify the Alaska Division of Elections contact path, replace requester placeholders, send from your email or portal session, and submit any response or files through the GitHub response form.
requests.responseAction: Use the Submit received records button after any email, portal reply, fee estimate, denial, redirect, or production.

requests.requestedRecords: Machine-readable official 2024 General President and U.S. Senate rows at the same precinct, precinct-split, township, ward, vote-center, or lowest maintained subcounty grain; field definitions; county manifest; certification/finality status; turnout/registration denominator rows; geometry/crosswalks; historical baselines; and administration-context records.
requests.evidenceSummary: Official ENR county category JSON files are loaded, but ordinary public ENR archive paths expose county-level candidate summaries and turnout/statistics data, not same-grain precinct/subcounty President plus U.S. Senate rows. Indiana reports 5,147 precincts and 1,342 precinct splits in the retained statewide precinct-count PDF.
requests.preparedAction: Prepared the request packet, statewide routing summary, county fallback tracker, and sendable email draft.
requests.manualUserAction: Send the statewide Indiana Election Division request first. Use county routing only if the state confirms no statewide export exists.
requests.responseAction: Submit any state reply, county redirect, fee estimate, denial, field layout, or produced export through the GitHub response form.

requests.requestedRecords: For Nevada jurisdictions outside loaded Clark, Washoe, and Humboldt coverage: official 2024 General local President rows and same-grain U.S. Senate rows; turnout/registration denominators; precinct/portion geometry or crosswalks; CVR availability/exports; audit, L&A, tabulator/EMS logs, custody, incident, correction, recount, and litigation records.
requests.evidenceSummary: Clark, Washoe, and Humboldt CVR/local review rows are loaded. Fourteen other Nevada jurisdictions remain request-tracked because no parser-ready 2024 President plus U.S. Senate local export, SOV workbook, or CVR export has been retained from ordinary official paths.
requests.preparedAction: Prepared the jurisdiction packet JSON and a state-level email draft that points to county-specific follow-up.
requests.manualUserAction: Use the Nevada county-clerk contact path to send county-specific requests or route through state guidance. Verify each county custodian before sending.
requests.responseAction: Submit any county response, redirect, produced export, or fee/denial notice through the GitHub response form with the county name.

requests.requestLabel: New York missing county-equivalent local rows
requests.requestedRecords: Official 2024 General local or election-district President rows and same-grain U.S. Senate rows for county equivalents still outside normalized local review coverage; turnout or voter-history rows; registered-voter denominator timing; ED geometry/crosswalks; audit/CVR/recount/correction/incident/litigation records; and stable public URLs for Oswego official PDF/Excel artifacts.
requests.evidenceSummary: Monroe and many county local rows are loaded, but Oswego has an official public PDF/Excel lead not yet parsed and 11 other county equivalents remain request-path blockers. NYSBOE enrollment reports are denominator leads only until paired with ballots-cast or voter-history rows.
requests.preparedAction: Prepared county-equivalent packet metadata and a state-level draft that points to NYSBOE FOIL and county board routing.
requests.manualUserAction: Use NYSBOE FOIL for state-maintained records and county board contacts for county-specific local rows. Verify the relevant county board before sending.
requests.responseAction: Submit received files, stable URLs, county redirects, fee notices, or denials through the GitHub response form.

requests.requestedRecords: Official 2024 General Election State Canvass and Certificate PDF/static export or machine-readable county-level certified result table for President and United States Representative; write-in or canvass-adjustment rows; certification date; source URL; and turnout denominator field definitions if turnout is supplied.
requests.evidenceSummary: The official ElectionID 684 app/export is retained but labeled unofficial and totals 194 President votes and 184 U.S. House votes below the current certified-style staging rows. Tested SOS asset paths did not reveal the certified State Canvass and Certificate.
requests.preparedAction: Prepared the source request packet, evidence references, and sendable draft for the SOS public-records path.
requests.manualUserAction: Send through the South Dakota public-records portal. Use county auditors only if the state cannot provide a reconciled statewide certified export.
requests.responseAction: Submit the SOS response, certified artifact, redirect, fee estimate, denial, or county-auditor production through the GitHub response form.
